descriptions.w3d_d29g_weapon_crate_setup_8004aa60: Weapon crate setup: applies scale 7, reads Crate.Contents and maps the name through the 36-entry weapon name table to the kind at +36, logging and setting an error text for an unknown name; then reads the weapon record's text key and builds the display text at +148 as the count (or the encoded infinity glyph when -1), ' x ' and the title.
